proposal.summary: The documented `main-protection` ruleset (deletion, non_fast_forward) plus required_linear_history. Compatible with direct pushes to main and with PUBLICATION.md ledger entry 1: no pull_request rule, no required_status_checks rule, bypass_actors stays empty. The history this proposal was derived against has zero merge commits, so the added rule refuses nothing the documented workflow does.
proposal.not_a_reading: This file describes a proposal. It is not proof that main is protected; only an administrator's apply and a readback (docs/governance/RUNBOOK.md) are.
